subject.title: fix: stop node alerts replaying after Gateway restart

question: Is deterministic pairing-state coverage plus an after-fix redacted Gateway/node restart run sufficient to accept the permanent canonical-pairing alert gate for upgrades?
rationale: Only maintainers can accept the upgrade contract for persisted pairing metadata and decide whether test-only evidence is enough for this user-visible Gateway behavior.

options.title: Require runtime proof and pairing review
options.body: Add a redacted after-fix run showing one alert for a newly approved node and no replay after reconnect or Gateway restart, then review the canonical identity migration before merge.

options.title: Accept deterministic proof only
options.body: Merge based on the atomic-claim and migration tests while explicitly accepting that the fixed behavior was not observed in a real Gateway/node setup.
